stem_book: If p₁, p₂, p₃ are the principal values of following trigonometric equations: (I) sinθ = −1/√2 (II) cosθ = −√3/2 (III) tanθ = √3 − 2, then (a) p₁ < p₂ < p₃ (b) p₁ < p₃ < p₂ (c) p₃ < p₁ < p₂ (d) p₂ < p₃ < p₁
derived: b (numerically-least principal values −π/4, 5π/6, −π/12) or d (smallest in [0, 2π): 5π/4, 5π/6, 11π/12)
reason: Convention-dependent: the book defines principal value both as the numerically least angle (gives key b) and as the solution in [0, 2π) (gives option d); both are printed options, so no unique answer as printed.
